sum((max_over_time(request_operation_total{namespace="$namespace", operation="$operation", deployment="$deployment", pod="", node=""}[5m]) -

sum by (operation, namespace) (
increase(request_operation_total{namespace="$namespace", operation="$operation", deployment="$deployment", pod="", node=""}[5m]))

)
